question: Parul started walking towards the north. After walking for 300 metres she turned right and walked for 400 metres. Then she turned right and walked for 500 metres. She then turned left and walked for 200 metres. Again, she turned left and walked for 200 metres. Finally she turned left and walked for 200 metres. In which direction and how far is Parul from her starting position ? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
